name: Steam
notes: Windows Steam client, one per bottle. Install with `SteamSetup.exe /S`, then run C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\Steam.exe. On the wrapped arm64 runtime the runtime itself applies its steam-web-helper rule to steamwebhelper.exe; Tether sets no extra flags. Verified so far: silent install, client bootstrap, steamwebhelper and renderer processes start. Login and game launch are not verified yet.
